tldr: Lilith in the 12th house: the deeply buried and exiled self
body: Lilith in the 12th house: the deeply buried and exiled self. Where you reclaim what was repressed below awareness. Watch: hidden rage and self-undoing until it is made conscious. The disowned self is buried in the unconscious; raw instinct you may not see, surfacing in private. The disowned self buried in the unconscious: at once a wound and a gateway. Unexamined it blocks expression; explored, it becomes a source of intuitive depth.
business: Reclaiming hidden power and refusing to disappear brings it to light.
shadow: Self-sabotage from the dark, or suppressed feelings slipping out as passive-aggressive behavior.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
